cards.text:
Preview exercise

Smallville Regional

Begins paused with only the traffic below. Resume when your plan is ready.

Select TRAIN101, assign runway 27, then clear its approach. Resume to watch automatic approach guidance capture final and descend. Pause whenever you want to inspect its distance, altitude, or fuel.

TRAIN101
C172 · 5,000 ft · 90 kt
Heading 270° · No runway

Preview exercise

Smallville Regional

Begins paused with only the traffic below. Resume when your plan is ready.

NEAR101 is closer, but FAST102 is faster. Compare distance ÷ speed before choosing the arrival order. Land FAST102 first, then NEAR101, with enough spacing for this model’s protected runway area.

NEAR101
C172 · 9,000 ft · 90 kt
Heading 270° · RWY 27
FAST102
B738 · 5,500 ft · 140 kt
Heading 270° · RWY 27

Preview exercise

Metro International

Begins paused with only the traffic below. Resume when your plan is ready.

SOUTH101 and EAST102 are at the same altitude on converging courses. Before resuming, assign one aircraft a different altitude. Maintain at least 1,000 feet of vertical separation through six shift seconds without a model separation alert.

SOUTH101
B738 · 5,000 ft · 140 kt
Heading 180° · No runway
EAST102
B738 · 5,000 ft · 140 kt
Heading 090° · No runway

Preview exercise

Crosswind City

Begins paused with only the traffic below. Resume when your plan is ready.

MED101 requests medical priority on runway 18. ROUT102 is assigned runway 27. These runways share one protected movement area in this model. Land MED101 first, then ROUT102 after the area clears.

MED101 · Priority
B738 · 6,000 ft · 140 kt
Heading 180° · RWY 18
ROUT102
A320 · 6,000 ft · 135 kt
Heading 270° · RWY 27
